paragraphs: Syscon Justice Systems sells corrections software built around an offender management system called Elite. Elite is presented as a fully-integrated case management tool that covers all corrections processes, with a module overview available to download.

The homepage describes over 35 years working with corrections agencies, and software that helps clients reduce risk and make an impact on public safety. Services listed beside the software include business analysis, software implementation, training, project management, and technical support.

The about page places offices in North America, the UK, and Australia. It describes Syscon as a member of the Harris Computer Systems family, building products intended to make the system safe and efficient for corrections staff and offenders.

quote.text: Working closely with our clients, we're on a mission to transform traditional offender management.
